login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your email and password. We will email you a code next.
login.invalid: Email or password is not right
login.resetDone: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new one.

code.title: Enter your code

code.needNew: That code can no longer be used. Send a new one.

reset.intro: Enter your email and we will send you a link.
reset.sent: If an account exists, a link is on its way.
